question: If (sinA+cosA)/(cosA)=(17)/(12), the find the value of sin A and cos A respectively.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given, (sin A + cos A) ÷ cos A = 17/12

⇒ tan A + 1 = 17/12 ⇒ tan A = 5/12

Since tan A = Perpendicular ÷ Base, Perpendicular = 5 and Base = 12.

Using the 5-12-13 Pythagorean triplet, Hypotenuse = 13.

⇒ sin A = 5/13 and cos A = 12/13

**∴ The correct answer is 5/13, 12/13.**
